sheet_id_or_date: NAS-6254-EN (7/21) A056T581, (c)2021 Cummins Inc. (distributor copy of official PDF; 10/19 rev at https://mart.cummins.com/imagelibrary/data/assetfiles/0058055.pdf has identical numbers)
engine: Cummins QSJ999G, naturally aspirated, V-twin air cooled, aluminum block
sound_note: 65 dB(A) at 23 ft (7 m) at normal load; 'quietest point at a normal load, sound performance may be affected by installation'. The older 01/17 rev defines normal load as typical household consumption of 3 kW.

exercise: Exercise modes settable for time, date and frequency; patented 'Crank only' exercise mode cranks engine and runs diagnostics without starting
warranty: 5 years / 2000 hours base limited warranty; extended warranties available (RA ATS: 2 year)
transfer_switch: Not included - sold separately (RA Series ATS, SE and NSE, indoor/outdoor, UL 1008)

other.fuel: Single fuel - natural gas or propane vapor, field selectable (set to natural gas from factory)
other.fuel_pressure_kpa: min NG 0.87 / LP 1.49; max NG 3.0 / LP 3.0
other.battery_charger: 4 A battery charger + battery charging alternator
other.operating_temperature: 122 F (50 C) to -40 F (-40 C) per performance section; standard models 0 F (-18 C) out of the box, 'E' extreme cold weather models to -40 F; Extreme Cold Weather Kit A054B984 for below 0 F on standard models
other.derate: derate 3.5% per 300 m (1000 ft) and 1% per 5.5 C (10 F) above the full-rating point listed per model
other.load_management: Intelligent load management - controls up to 4 loads; Load Add/Load Shed Device A051C329 controls up to 2 x 50 A loads
other.code_compliance: UL 2200; CSA 22.2 and B149.1; EPA emissions; NFPA 37 - 18 inches
other.clearances_from_install_drawing: As labelled on sheet p.3 plan views (mm (in)): 458 (18) MINIMUM to surface wall behind the engine/breaker end; 1524 (60) MINIMUM TO SURFACE WALL and 915 (36) MINIMUM UNOBSTRUCTED SPACE on one air-flow side, 762 (30) MINIMUM UNOBSTRUCTED SPACE on the other air-flow side; 1524 (60) MINIMUM TO SURFACE/WALL and 458 (18) MINIMUM OBSTRUCTED SPACE at the alternator end; R1524 (60) MINIMUM AROUND ENTIRE GENERATOR SET TO ANY OPENING IN AN OCCUPIED SPACE (windows, doors, vents). other.footprint_mounting: Mounting holes 2x dia 15 mm (0.6 in) at 730 mm (28.7 in) centres; lifting holes 4x dia 32 mm (1.3 in) at 729 mm (28.7 in)
other.electrical_entry: Dia 35 mm (1.4 in) - '1" conduit fitting' electrical connection (AC and DC)
other.mounting_pad: Concrete composite mounting pad, 3 in thick, 1 in overhang: A052A795 (single), A057M349 (5-pack)
other.estop: E-stop kit A044Z051 (external); approved location shown on drawing, mounting hole not provided
other.standby_rating_basis: Standby rating: no sustained overload capability (equivalent to fuel stop power per ISO3046, AS2789, DIN6271, BS5514)
other.rated_power_derate_point: full rated power at 25 C (77 F) and 2100 m (6900 ft)

note: Sheet gives NO kW rating table - only rated amps (NG/LPV) at 120/240 V; standby_kw left null per no-conversion rule. Model name implies kW (13). Output breaker is 'Single 100A circuit breaker, UL certified (On all models)'. LP fuel given in ft3/hr, m3/hr and BTU/hr only - no gal/hr on the 7/21 sheet (lp_gph left null). Oil capacity, exercise sound level and frequency regulation % not on sheet (frequency regulation stated as 'Isochronous'; steady-state freq variation +/-1.25%). cylinders=2 from 'V twin' in engine design line. Older 01/17 rev (NAS-6254) had DIFFERENT numbers: max inlet pressure 13.0 in H2O for both fuels, weights 540 lb for RS17A/20A/20AC, and much higher NG consumption (e.g. RS20A full load 300 ft3/hr) with LP gal/hr rows. Those are superseded; confirm the sheet revision against the unit's installation manual before sizing gas pipe.
